description.narrative: The purpose of the contract is to: 1. Establish a third party monitoring (TPM) system to independently monitor, verify and analyze the results of assistance activities in Syria funded by USAID's Middle East Bureau (MEB); 2. Provide high quality research and analysis (R&A) services to inform USAID/MEB strategy, project, and activity design and implementation; and 3. Strengthen the capacity of USAID/MEB and implementing partners' (IPs) staff to improve performance monitoring and data analysis.
